card.name: "Next" before lower dose level
card.fires_on: The word "next" in dose-adjustment instructions, right before "lower" or "dosage level" (e.g. "reduce to the next lower dose"). It also fires weakly on timing words such as "hours", "scheduled" and "usual" before "dose" or "time".

modes.label: Next dose step
modes.description: "next" in instructions to move up or down to an adjacent dose level.
modes.example: reduce the daily dosage to the<< next>> lower dose as shown in Table 2

modes.label: Dose timing words
modes.description: Timing words in missed-dose or spacing instructions, before "dose", "time" or "intervals".
modes.example: Advise the patient to take the next prescribed dose at the<< usual>> time.

card.writes: It suppresses place words like area and region and promotes period and moment words, which fits a time or step noun coming next.
card.plain: It marks the word "next" when a label says to step to the next lower or higher dose.
